instruction: Switch the default search engine to Yahoo.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated to Chrome settings > Search engine section and changed default search engine from Google to Microsoft Bing in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome settings, navigate to specific settings sections, use dialogs/dropdowns to change setting values
metadata.task_rationale: Same search engine change pattern with different target (Yahoo instead of Bing) to verify the capability generalizes across options
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Chrome default search engine to Yahoo. Uses same official default_search_engine getter and match_in_list metric as original task. Accepts both 'Yahoo!' and 'Yahoo' name variants.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'default_search_engine' correctly reads Chrome's Preferences JSON file to extract the default search engine short_name, which is the right state for verifying this instruction.
Metric 'match_in_list' correctly receives the rules dict with 'expected' key and checks if the getter result is in the expected list.
Expected values ['Yahoo!', 'Yahoo'] cover both common name variants of Yahoo's search engine in Chrome.
Postconfig correctly kills and relaunches Chrome to ensure the Preferences file is flushed to disk before the getter reads it.
Single-step instruction is fully covered by the evaluator - no missing requirements.
